page: Microsoft Azure ND128isr_NDR_GB200_v6 belongs to the GPU Accelerated family, provisioned as an isolated environment running on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system incorporates an arm64 host processor architecture supplying 128 dedicated vCPUs. System memory totals 864 GB of RAM, yielding an allocation of 6.75 GB per core. The dedicated virtual CPU assignment guarantees uninterrupted execution capacity for compute tasks coordinating accelerator operations.

The core processing capability relies on four NVIDIA Blackwell GB200 GPUs offering 768 GB of total GPU memory. To address the I/O demands of high-throughput training and inference, the instance integrates 16,460 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. High-bandwidth, low-latency inter-node communication is enabled through RDMA network support, facilitating multi-node cluster scaling without host networking overhead.

From an efficiency perspective, the bundling of 16,460 GB local NVMe storage and 768 GB total GPU memory delivers substantial hardware density within a single isolated node. This configuration mitigates the latency and network overhead associated with detached object or block storage during intensive model checkpointing. The dedicated arm64 host architecture eliminates multi-tenant contention, although the specialized, high-tier configuration trades general-purpose flexibility for concentrated accelerator throughput.

The ND128isr_NDR_GB200_v6 is engineered for large-scale distributed machine learning training, frontier generative AI foundation model development, complex neural network fine-tuning, and high-concurrency LLM inference deployments requiring massive GPU memory footprints and fast local scratch storage.
description: Microsoft Azure ND128isr_NDR_GB200_v6 is an isolated, accelerator-focused instance designed for demanding artificial intelligence and high-performance computing tasks. Built on an arm64 architecture, the host platform supplies 128 dedicated vCPUs alongside 864 GB of system RAM, maintaining an allocation of 6.75 GB per core. Acceleration is driven by four NVIDIA Blackwell GB200 GPUs delivering a combined 768 GB of high-bandwidth GPU memory. For data staging and high-speed scratch space, the instance integrates 16,460 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, complemented by RDMA capability for ultra-low latency interconnect fabrics. The consolidation of extensive accelerator memory and dense local solid-state storage minimizes remote storage bottlenecks during training runs. This hardware configuration is suited for frontier large language model pre-training, distributed deep learning, intensive parameter fine-tuning, and high-throughput multi-modal inference pipelines.
